parameters.query: WITH borrar AS (DELETE FROM clasificacion WHERE message_id = '{{ $json.metadata['message-id'] }}' AND error_ia = TRUE RETURNING id) SELECT '{{ $json.metadata['message-id'] }}' AS message_id, (SELECT id FROM clasificacion WHERE message_id = '{{ $json.metadata['message-id'] }}' AND error_ia IS NOT TRUE LIMIT 1) AS id;

parameters.query: SELECT DISTINCT ON (message_id) TRUE AS reintento, message_id, buzon, remitente, asunto, fecha, cuerpo FROM clasificacion WHERE error_ia = TRUE AND COALESCE(message_id, '') <> '' AND COALESCE(motivo, '') NOT LIKE 'No se pudo leer%' ORDER BY message_id, id DESC LIMIT 30;
